'''Campbell:''' {{legend0|#a5b0ff|40–50%}} {{legend0|#7996e2|50–60%}} | title = Governor | before_election = [[Terry Branstad]] | before_party = Republican Party (United States) | after_election = [[Terry Branstad]] | after_party = Republican Party (United States) | running_mate1 = '''[[Joy Corning]]''' | running_mate2 = [[Leonard Boswell]] }} {{ElectionsIA}} The '''1994 Iowa gubernatorial election''' took place on November 8, 1994. Incumbent [[Republican Party (United States)|Republican]] [[Governor of Iowa|Governor]] [[Terry Branstad]] narrowly defeated a primary challenger by 11,419 votes. On the [[Democratic Party (United States)|Democratic]] side, [[Attorney General of Iowa|State Attorney General]] [[Bonnie Campbell (lawyer)|Bonnie Campbell]] won her party's nomination. Branstad ultimately won re-election to a fourth term as governor, defeating Campbell in a landslide. This was the last time until [[2010 Iowa gubernatorial election|2010]] that a Republican was elected Governor of Iowa, when Branstad defeated incumbent Democrat [[Chet Culver]]. ==Republican primary==
